category_title: Mature students with depression and insomnia focused on vocational progression
minimal_context: Colin is reviewing his upcoming attendance schedule for the specialized cookery course to prepare for his progression to a mainstream painting and decorating course.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Colin, please fill out this attendance schedule for the next month of the cookery course so we can plan your progression to the intensive painting and decorating course.

STUDENT: I don't know if I can commit to writing down every day. I've been suffering from severe insomnia and depression for the past year.

TUTOR: You just need to make sure you come to class regularly.

STUDENT: I do want to progress onto the mainstream course, but I have a real fear of relapsing and subsequently not being able to finish the course.

TUTOR: Try your best to wake up on time and get here.

STUDENT: It's not that simple. I was worried about not being regular… about going into some kind of slide and not getting off my bottom and getting out and doing it …and that I might tail off.

options.A: Provide a clear beginning and end for each task when reviewing the upcoming attendance schedule.
options.B: Repeatedly stress that any relapses will be accommodated and the student's place in the course held open.
options.C: Create a positive and emotional classroom environment for the student throughout the specialized cookery course.
options.D: Introduce the situation to the student, determine their activities and functions, and discuss the course norms.
